title: Open your shop
headline: Open your *shop*
sub: Sign up, tell Taskiem about your business, and be found.

bridge.en: The shop is open but the shelves are empty. What goes on them?
bridge.pcm: Shop don open but shelf dey empty. Wetin go dey inside?

flow.action: Talks to a customer across the glass counter while two phones buzz in his hand; he glances at them, grins and shakes his head
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter
flow.camera: slow push-in, medium shot, warm light

flow.action: Looks at an empty shelf, then at a stack of unopened plain boxes on the counter, and nods with his hands on his hips
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter
flow.camera: medium shot, a gentle pan to the boxes

en: Meet Ikenna, who runs Techline Gadgets in Ikeja. He signs up with WhatsApp, and Taskiem sends a code.
Taskiem asks him to agree to the terms.
What is the business called? Techline Gadgets.
Then his own name, Ikenna Nwachukwu.
What does he sell? Phones and gadgets, number four.
How do customers pay? Cash and transfer.
Done. On Taskiem, free for fourteen days.
pcm: Meet Ikenna, wey dey run Techline Gadgets for Ikeja. He sign up with WhatsApp, and Taskiem go send code.
Taskiem go ask make he agree to the terms.
He choose business, no be workflows.
Wetin be the business name? Techline Gadgets.
Then his own name, Ikenna Nwachukwu.
Wetin he dey sell? Phones and gadgets, number four.
How customers dey pay? Cash and transfer.
E don do. Free for fourteen days.

en: Ikenna wants resellers to find him.
He turns on Be found in Explore.
He types his area: Computer Village, Ikeja.
His card shows his line and area.
Kehinde, a reseller, opens Find a business.
Techline is listed, as Phones and gadgets.
pcm: Ikenna want make resellers find am.
He turn on Be found for Explore.
He type im area: Computer Village, Ikeja.
Im card show im line and area.
Kehinde, reseller, open Find a business.
Techline dey list, as Phones and gadgets.
